_definitions.sat: arm component |a| >= 0.999 (x, y, z, rx, ry, rz; gripper excluded)
_definitions.lifted: both finger sides touch the target body (MuJoCo contact dist <= 0) and target rise >= 30 mm, obs >= wait (SL5g #3)
_definitions.stages: (1) calls npz actions_policy (2) joint_refined != joint_reference (float32), EE change = FK(panda_grip_site) (3) conversion.saturated_rows / max_abs_correction (4) actions_response (5) actions_executed
_definitions.first_stage: vla = policy row already saturated; conv_on_to_row = clipped by the conversion on a row TO changed; conv_carry = clipped on a row TO did not change; unclipped = saturated without clipping
_definitions.Dstar: FK(joint_refined[k,4]) - FK(joint_reference[k,4]) (mm, base axes = world axes)
_definitions.windup_run: maximal run of consecutive calls with conversion.saturated_rows non-empty and cos(Dstar_k, Dstar_{k-1}) > 0.5
_definitions.conversion_C_state: d^ / D^ start at zero in every call (AG3S/adapters/panda/action.py joint_chunk_to_delta_chunk); no state is carried between calls
_definitions.mujoco_ref_rows: call obs sim state, arm set to joint_reference rows 0..4 (bowl stays), non-robot geom_margin 30 mm; neither_within_30mm = no non-target non-table body and no table within 30 mm of any robot geom at all 5 rows
_definitions.z_attribution: sum over lifted calls of eef_obs_z(o+5) - FK_z(joint_reference[k,4]) (mm), split TO changed / unchanged
_definitions.row_dz: z of FK(refined row) - FK(reference row) for TO-changed rows; up/down threshold 0.5 mm
_definitions.centroid_offset: grasp.tip_alignment.centroid_m (AG3S manipulated centroid, base) minus MuJoCo target body position (base) at the call obs
